# Crypto feature catalogue

*Generated by `python -m research.brain.crypto.features catalog` from the definitions in `research/brain/crypto/features/`. Do not edit by hand.*

62 features, signature `4f16baef7099` (crypto cube v2). One row per UTC minute, 24x7. Every feature at minute t uses only cube rows with ts <= t (checked by `research/brain/tests/test_crypto_features.py`). Labels are not features: see `crypto/labels.py`. Lookback `60m` = the last 60 minutes, `7d` = the last 7 days (across midnight and weekends).

| `atr14_1h_pct` | 1 | 900m | minutes.high, minutes.low, minutes.close | ATR(14) of rolling 60-minute bars ending at t, t-60, ..., t-780 (true range uses the close 60 minutes earlier), % of the close. |

| `rv_ratio_1h_24h` | 1 | 1440m | minutes.close | Last hour's realised vol divided by the last 24 hours' hourly average (above 1 = busier than usual). |
